summary.text: Palpatine uses a three-winged Theta-class shuttle to reach Mustafar and recover the injured Vader. Its wings fold upward for landing. The film design anticipates the later Lambda shuttle, while this dossier retains the original craft’s own identity.

records.scope: First scoped review of an existing legacy craft: all twelve inherited fields assessed, original description, selected type/hull boundaries and individually cited work/context links. Numeric identity, title, slug and import provenance retained.
limitations: The historic film Databank gives broad Theta class, maker, length, height and transport type. The inherited T-2c suffix remains unsupported in this selected set, so the published model is broader while the inherited title and slug remain unchanged.

Values explicitly marked 2007 film profile are historical official-reference metadata, not a blanket current-canon technical certification. The Expanded Universe tab was not read or used. No exact crew five, passengers sixteen, one million credits, cargo, endurance, atmospheric speed or hyperdrive class established.

Palpatine is a user/passenger; no piloting fact is inferred from flew in. The three-winged design is distinct from the Lambda and from other Republic attack shuttles. A practical boarding ramp and deliberate design resemblance are production facts, not release events, full credits or universal fictional construction rules.

Only these selected facts and connections reviewed. Other specifications, precise variants and full appearance/credit history remain incomplete. Unestablished values are withheld from published facts and previews while raw text/source remain recoverable.

No new records, episode rows, credits, editions or release events. Original-USA launch research scope retained. Archived pages are historical official primary material preserved by a third party; public access is not an open text/image licence.
